name: International Tiger Day
description: Established in 2010 to raise awareness of wild tiger conservation. India holds ~70% of wild tigers.

name: World Lion Day
description: In India, spotlights the Asiatic lion surviving in Gujarat's Gir Forest.

name: World Elephant Day
description: Spotlights threats facing Asian and African elephants, including habitat loss and human-elephant conflict.

name: World Rhino Day
description: Celebrates all five rhino species; in India centers on the one-horned rhino.

name: World Sparrow Day
description: Started by Nature Forever Society in Nashik, India, to raise awareness of house sparrows and common birds.
